question: In which sport did India defeat Pakistan 2-1 to lift the Men's Junior Asia Cup in 2023, overtaking them in winning the maximum titles at the prestigious event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India defeated Pakistan 2-1 to lift the Men's Junior Asia Cup in 2023.
 
• This victory allowed India to overtake Pakistan in winning the maximum titles at the prestigious event.
 
• The Men's Junior Asia Cup is a field hockey tournament organized by the Asian Hockey Federation.
 
• India has a strong history in the Men's Junior Asia Cup, having won multiple titles in previous editions.
 
• The 2023 victory was significant in showcasing the talent and future potential of Indian hockey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Hockey Federation (AHF)**

 
 
• The governing body for field hockey in Asia.
 
• Organizes various tournaments, including the Men's Junior Asia Cup.
 
• Works to promote and develop the sport across the Asian continent.
 
 
 
• **Field Hockey**
 
 
• A popular team sport played on grass or artificial turf.
 
• Each team has 11 players, including a goalkeeper.
 
• The objective is to score goals by hitting a ball into the opponent's net using a hockey stick.
 
 
 
• **Junior Hockey Tournaments**
 
 
• Competitions typically for players under the age of 21.
 
• Serve as a platform for young talent to showcase their skills.
 
• Help in the development and scouting of future national team players.
 
 
 
• **India-Pakistan Hockey Rivalry**
 
 
• One of the most intense rivalries in field hockey.
 
• Both countries have a rich history and tradition in the sport.
 
• Matches between India and Pakistan often draw large audiences and high viewership.
